messages:
Alex (Sales): Hey team — handing off Rivermoss. Quick summary: Mid-market, signed 2024-06-01, 12mo term, dedicated trial in us-west. Renewal check: 2025-10-01 flagged as a medium risk if we don't stabilize infra and complete enablement. Current onboarding status: ~60% (SSO + dataset ingest failing). Blockers: Okta cert mismatch -> 502s for SSO, ingestion errors causing 5xx on batch import. They hit this during testing yesterday and paused work.
Maria (CS): Acked. I can lead onboarding + enablement. Need customer contacts, sample logs, and whether we can run a live session Wed 9am PT. Also note: they asked for a quick run-through of model routing & cost controls.
Alex (Sales): Customer contacts: sam@rivermoss.com (Platform Lead) and carla@rivermoss.com (PM). Sam gave permission for temporary log access last week but wants it scoped. I'll intro you both in an email after this thread. The onboarding doc + dataset sample is here: https://drive.redwood/rivermoss/onboarding-snapshot
Jon (Eng): Reproduced Okta cert failure locally. Error: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" when redirecting to their IdP. I'll open ENG-7892 and patch our Okta client config. ETA: EOD today for a hotfix; need customer to upload IdP cert or give us a metadata XML.
Maria (CS): Jon — can you confirm whether the hotfix is config-only or needs a deploy? If deploy, we should plan a maintenance window with the customer.
Jon (Eng): Config-only change for the client -> no rolling deploy needed, but backend restart required on the dedicated instance. I'll coordinate with infra. Also: for ingestion, I need a sanitized sample of the CSV that failed and the error logs (500 stacktrace). Maria, can you get that from Sam?
Lisa (Support): I'll create a synthetic monitor for rivermoss ingest endpoints and set an alert if 5xx rate > 1% over 5m. If it trips, paging goes to oncall + Jon by default. Adding a ticket to our queue now.
Alex (Sales): Done — intro email going out in 10m with permission note for log/metadata upload. Sam agreed to share IdP metadata XML and one sanitized CSV.
Jon (Eng): Created ENG-7892: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7892. Patch in PR-456; requires restart of dedicated host rivermoss-dedicated-01. @infra-bot can you queue a restart, target ASAP but after Sam confirms maintenance window?
infra-bot: Deployment maintenance request received for rivermoss-dedicated-01. Queue position: 3. Please confirm approval and preferred ETA window in the ticket ENG-7892.
Maria (CS): Owners recap and next steps:
- Maria (CS): Lead onboarding, schedule enablement session Wed 09:00 PT, capture feedback & missing docs.
- Jon (Eng): Triage Okta cert (ENG-7892), ingest errors after sample received, prepare config patch and restart plan.
- Lisa (Support): Add monitors, handle escalations, create ticket SUPPORT-3421 for long-term monitoring rules.
- Alex (Sales): Customer liaison, secure IdP metadata + sample CSV, confirm maintenance window.
Maria (CS): I'll create a parent Jira epic CS-1220 and link ENG-7892 + SUPPORT-3421. Internal sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm go/no-go for restart. I'll also prepare a short feedback form for the enablement session so we capture their concerns on routing/costs.
Alex (Sales): Thanks. Renewal note: I'll mark this as "monitoring" risk in CRM and set a follow-up in 30 days to check adoption metrics (tokens/day, embeddings usage). If infra stabilizes and enablement completes, we should be fine.
Jon (Eng): Quick note on required access: to pull IdP cert we need either the metadata XML or a one-time SFTP/dropbox with the cert. Alex please confirm in intro email that Sam will upload to the onboarding folder. Otherwise we'll need a scoped IAM role to access S3 logs.
Maria (CS): Perfect. I'll run the enablement template and include a short walkthrough of "model routing & cost controls" and capture action items.
Lisa (Support): Logging the support ticket now: SUPPORT-3421 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUPPORT-3421). Assigning to myself and Jon for first 48h.
Alex (Sales): Email intro sent. Sam replied: "Uploading IdP metadata + one sanitized CSV to the shared folder. Maintenance window: Tue 15:00-16:00 PT works." He asked for a 30min pre-call before the restart.
Maria (CS): I'll schedule the 30min pre-call Tue 14:30 PT and the enablement Wed 09:00 PT. I'll add a short feedback capture doc and share it with the team after the session.
Jon (Eng): Confirmed I can do the restart Tue 15:10 PT after pre-call. Will push the config change and monitor health post-restart. I'll post updates to ENG-7892.
Lisa (Support): I'll stand by during the restart and monitor alerts. If the 5xx rate spikes >2%, I'll open an incident and page oncall.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the Jira epic link and calendar invites. Meeting owners locked.
Alex (Sales): Closing note: Renewal flag updated, owners assigned. Reach out in this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
